item.title: The Navy’s Expectations for the F/A-XX Fighter Are Rising. So Is Its Price Tag.
item.description: Chief of Naval Operations Daryl Caudle stressed that the sixth-gen fighter jet was urgently needed to replace the US Navy’s existing fleet of F/A-18 Super Hornets and EA-18G Growlers. The post The Navy’s Expectations for the F/A-XX Fighter Are Rising. So Is Its Price Tag. appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Do “Icebreaker” Ships Matter So Much?
item.description: As global warming continues and sea lanes open in the Arctic, the world’s major powers are pouring money into the construction of icebreaker ships. The post Why Do “Icebreaker” Ships Matter So Much? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How Internal Weapons Bays Replaced Hardpoints on Modern Aircraft
item.description: Internal bays are far harder to use than simple hardpoints—but can help to keep a stealth plane stealthy, while external weapons light up on enemy radar. The post How Internal Weapons Bays Replaced Hardpoints on Modern Aircraft appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: France’s Dassault Rafale vs. Russia’s Su-35 Super Flanker: Who Would Win?
item.description: In general, the Dassault Rafale’s sensor suite is superior to the Su-35’s, while the Russian jet enjoys advantages in speed and maneuverability. The post France’s Dassault Rafale vs. Russia’s Su-35 Super Flanker: Who Would Win? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Does the US Army Have an Air Wing?
item.description: Most of the US Army’s planes were spun off into the Air Force in 1947, but it continues to operate a handful of fixed-wing aircraft for logistics and ISR purposes. The post Why Does the US Army Have an Air Wing? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the B-1B Lancer Bomber Came Back from the Dead
item.description: The B-1 Lancer program was curtailed in the 1970s as an unnecessary waste of taxpayer dollars. That changed when Ronald Reagan entered office. The post How the B-1B Lancer Bomber Came Back from the Dead appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The OA-1K Skyraider II Has Something Very Strange on Its Nose
item.description: The Skyraider II is the first US Air Force plane since the Vietnam War to have a propeller instead of a jet engine—but there are good reasons for it. The post The OA-1K Skyraider II Has Something Very Strange on Its Nose appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: A Misreading of the Iranian Opposition
item.description: A recent article gets the measure of one of Iran’s resistance groups all wrong. The post A Misreading of the Iranian Opposition appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Nuri al-Maliki Is the Last Thing Iraq Needs
item.description: The last time Nuri al-Maliki was in power, corruption, mismanagement, extremism, and Iran ruled the roost in Iraq. The post Nuri al-Maliki Is the Last Thing Iraq Needs appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Syria Needs Federalism
item.description: A more decentralized Syria is a surer route to stability and prosperity. The post Why Syria Needs Federalism appeared first on The National Interest.
